title: Sonny White's Casimir-effect chip

tellings.quote:
Yeah, you have Sunny
White with who can engineer the Casemir
effect

plain: A researcher named Harold "Sonny" White can, in Jesse Michels's words, "engineer the Casimir effect". The Casimir effect is a tiny force that pulls two very close surfaces together, and it comes from empty space itself. Michels says this himself, in passing and without naming a source, as one example of people working toward exotic physics, presumably on a chip.
